playbook.claim: Extend affirmation value beyond the app session through a customizable home-screen widget and shareable wallpaper or image.
playbook.mechanism: Persistent ambient surfaces increase repeated exposure and create a built-in sharing path; test widget activation, daily return rate, wallpaper creation, shares, and subscription conversion against an in-app-card-only control.

playbook.claim: Use private chat import followed by a visible relationship-temperature score as the first value moment, then gate counterfactual reply simulations and weekly insights.
playbook.mechanism: A concrete score makes invisible relationship dynamics legible while on-device processing lowers privacy friction; test import completion, score-view rate, premium conversion, repeat analysis, and refund rate against a generic advice onboarding flow.

playbook.claim: Test AI-assisted localization as an overseas affiliate-content lane for creators who lack English fluency or foreign-market expertise.
playbook.mechanism: Use an AI workflow to translate and adapt one product angle for a target market, then compare localized posts with domestic-language posts on qualified clicks, affiliate conversion, production time, and refund rate.

playbook.claim: Add currency-aware, dry-run-safe refund and sales operations to digital-product marketing workflows.
playbook.mechanism: Read the sale currency before calculating partial refunds, validate inputs locally before authenticated requests, and require dry-run protection for mutations; test operational error rate, accidental mutation rate, refund handling time, and support workload across currencies.
